sloka: तच्च शूलं महत्तेन हते लवणराक्षसे ।पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां रुद्रस्य वशमन्वगात् ।। ७.६९.३८ ॥
transliteration: tacca śūlaṁ mahattena hate lavaṇarākṣase ।paśyatāṁ sarvadevānāṁ rudrasya vaśamanvagāt ।। 7.69.38 ॥

translations.english: And that great trident, after the demon Lavana was killed by Shatrughna, returned to the control of Rudra while all the gods watched.
